groups.name: Logging
groups.description: Logging controls for file output and verbosity.

items.label: Log Level
items.description: Allowed values: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR.

items.label: Log Full Asset Payloads
items.description: Use 1 to log full asset JSON at INFO; use 0 to log at DEBUG.

items.label: Log Window Autoclose Seconds
items.description: Auto-close delay for long-running script logs.

groups.name: API Users
groups.description: Snipe-IT API user selection for change attribution.

items.label: Static API User Name
items.description: Name from API_KEYS to always use. Use 'none' to prompt each session.

items.label: Prompt Cache Minutes
items.description: Minutes before a prompted user expires (sliding window).

items.label: Prompt Title
items.description: Title shown in the API user selection prompt.

items.label: Prompt Message
items.description: Message text shown in the API user selection prompt.

groups.name: Printer and Labels
groups.description: Label printer connection and sizing defaults.

items.label: Printer Type
items.description: Example: QL-720NW

items.label: Label Name
items.description: Brother QL label name or size code.

items.label: Label Width
items.description: Pixels (integer).

items.label: Label Height
items.description: Pixels (integer).

items.label: Labels Per Print
items.description: Integer count for each print operation.

items.label: Default Print
items.description: 1 to auto-print after label generation, 0 to disable.

groups.name: Testing
groups.description: Pytest runner options for the in-app test command.

items.label: Pytest Verbosity
items.description: 0 = default, 1 = -v, 2 = -vv.

items.label: Pytest Quiet Mode
items.description: 1 to add -q for quieter output.

items.label: Pytest Disable Capture
items.description: 1 to add -s so stdout prints live.

items.label: Pytest Fail Fast
items.description: 1 to add -x (stop on first failure).

items.label: Pytest Max Failures
items.description: Integer for --maxfail (0 disables).

items.label: Pytest Durations
items.description: Integer for --durations (0 disables).

items.label: Pytest Marker Expression
items.description: Passed to -m (e.g., readonly_network).

items.label: Pytest Keyword Expression
items.description: Passed to -k for test selection.

items.label: Pytest Additional Args
items.description: Extra args appended verbatim (e.g., --lf).

items.label: Pytest Targets
items.description: Optional paths or node IDs (space-separated).

items.label: Pytest Readonly Network
items.description: 1 to set READONLY_NETWORK=1 in the test run.

items.label: Pytest Readonly Asset Tags
items.description: Comma-separated asset tags for read-only tests.

items.label: Pytest Readonly API User
items.description: API user name for read-only tests (case-insensitive).

items.label: Pytest Readonly API Key
items.description: Override API key for read-only tests.

groups.name: GUI
groups.description: Main window layout and font settings.

items.label: Window State
items.description: Allowed values: zoomed, normal.

items.label: Font Family
items.description: Font family name used throughout the GUI.

items.label: Base Font Size
items.description: Default font size for most controls.

items.label: Tab Font Size
items.description: Font size for top tab labels.

items.label: Button Columns
items.description: Number of columns for function button grids.

items.label: Active Tab Color
items.description: Background color for active tab.

items.label: Inactive Tab Color
items.description: Background color for inactive tabs.

groups.name: Drop-Off
groups.description: Drop-off workflow controls and tracker defaults.

items.label: Box State Tracker Asset Tag
items.description: Asset tag for the shared tracker record.

items.label: Default Box Capacity
items.description: Integer number of items per box.

items.label: Drop-Off Status ID
items.description: Status ID applied on drop-off. Integer.

items.label: Pending Drop-Off Status ID
items.description: Status ID considered as 'Pending Drop-Off'. Integer.

items.label: MacBook Category ID
items.description: Category ID considered as a valid macbook/computer to be dropped off. Integer.

items.label: Drop-Off Charger Field Key
items.description: Custom field key for charger condition (e.g., _snipeit_chargeringoodcondition_6).

items.label: Drop-Off Cord Field Key
items.description: Custom field key for cord condition (e.g., _snipeit_cordingoodcondition_11).

items.label: Drop-Off Box Field Key
items.description: Custom field key for box label (e.g., _snipeit_box_number_5).

groups.name: Repairs
groups.description: Repair workflow status IDs and defaults.

items.label: Pending Repair Status ID
items.description: Status ID used when a repair is opened. Integer.

items.label: Repair Completed Status ID
items.description: Status ID used when returning from repair. Integer.

items.label: Repair Supplier ID
items.description: Supplier ID for new maintenance records. Integer.

items.label: Repair Maintenance Type
items.description: Maintenance type label or ID used when creating repairs.

items.label: Loaner Check-in Window (Days)
items.description: Max day difference between loaner checkout and maintenance start to auto-set loaner check-in.

items.label: Pants Shipping Status ID
items.description: Status ID applied in pants shipping. Integer.

items.label: Charger Category ID
items.description: Category ID used to filter charger models. Integer.

items.label: Charger Name Prefix
items.description: Prefix for charger asset names when a suffix is provided.

items.label: Charger Default Name
items.description: Name used when no suffix is provided.

items.label: Charger EA Name
items.description: Extension Attribute name that stores charger history.

items.label: Charger Serial Page Size
items.description: Jamf inventory page size for charger history lookups.

items.label: Status Search Limit
items.description: Max status labels to load for full list.

items.label: Status Search Limit (Filtered)
items.description: Max status labels to load for filtered search.

items.label: User Search Limit
items.description: Max users to load for filtered search.

groups.name: Battery Sync
groups.description: Battery sync field keys and EA names.

items.label: Battery Sync Dry Run
items.description: 1 to prevent writes to Snipe-IT.

items.label: Battery Sync Verify SSL
items.description: 1 to verify SSL certificates, 0 to skip.

items.label: Battery Sync Rate Limit Delay
items.description: Seconds between API calls (float).

items.label: Battery Sync Test Serial
items.description: Optional serial for live updates when in test mode.

items.label: Battery Sync Debug Verbose
items.description: 1 to log extra EA details.

items.label: Battery Sync Debug Only First N
items.description: Limit processing to N devices (blank or 0 for all).

items.label: Battery Sync Debug Show EA Values
items.description: 1 to include EA values in debug logs.

items.label: Battery Data Field Key
items.description: Custom field key for battery data in Snipe-IT.

items.label: Battery EA Name (Design)
items.description: Jamf EA name for design capacity.

items.label: Battery EA Name (Maximum)
items.description: Jamf EA name for maximum capacity.

items.label: Battery EA Name (Condition)
items.description: Jamf EA name for condition.

items.label: Jamf Sync Dry Run
items.description: 1 to prevent updates in Jamf.

items.label: Jamf Sync Verify SSL
items.description: 1 to verify SSL certificates, 0 to skip.

items.label: Jamf Sync Rate Limit Delay
items.description: Seconds between API calls (float).

items.label: Sync Computers
items.description: 1 to sync computer inventory.

items.label: Sync Mobile Devices
items.description: 1 to sync mobile device inventory.

items.label: Jamf Sync Test Serial
items.description: Optional serial to update live while others dry-run.

items.label: Jamf PreStage Dry Run
items.description: 1 to prevent updates in Jamf.

items.label: Jamf PreStage Verify SSL
items.description: 1 to verify SSL certificates, 0 to skip.

items.label: Jamf PreStage Rate Limit Delay
items.description: Seconds between API calls (float).

items.label: Jamf PreStage Strict Removal Guard
items.description: 1 to block deletes when removal is incomplete.

items.label: Jamf PreStage Delete After Remove
items.description: 1 to delete inventory after PreStage updates.

items.label: Jamf PreStage Debug Verbose
items.description: 1 to log extra Jamf PreStage details.

items.label: Email Warning Patterns
items.description: Semicolon-separated regex patterns.

items.label: Asset Tag Regex
items.description: Regex used to validate asset tag input (e.g., ^\d{4,5}$).
